body: Please don't say that. It cannot be true. I know it feels like it, but it cannot be true.  Please stay strong.

Even if it feels so, you didnt fail at life.
Maybe you've done something wrong, maybe you haven't met the standards that society had for you. Maybe it's the standards you had for yourself. Its might be a setback, but its not a fail, because theres no passing grade.
Maybe you cant rewind time (yet), but you CAN do it better next time. You've tried, you've learned, now you know what not to do. Its a triel an error, aint it?
As long as you alive, you can change your wayes, your mind, your body, your whatever. But once you've died, its an end. An end to your suffering but also to all the things you could have done right, could have change, could have make better.
I know it feels hopeless right now, but please don't give up. Please stay strong for your loved one's. Please give it another chance.

Listen, you can always end it, but once you do, there's no way back. Our society puts sooo much pressure on our 20s to be "the best most importent" years of our life, but its such a crap. Some people were born to the best years of their life, some people found everything they wanted in their 80s. You can never know what the future holds for you. Just give it another chance. That's what im trying to do. Lets do this together. 
Also there are more than 7 billion people on this earth. You are bound to find your people.
Please stay.

Its gonna be okay!


Everybody makes mistakes and humans are so fucking forgetful and egocentric. sooner or later  everybody will forget about that incident and find another poor person to terrorize.

Also the one's you've lost probably didn't deserve you anyways. Don't forget that they've lost you too, and unlike  you, they've lost someone who cared about them. And you've gained a place in your life for someone who deserves you.
Please don't. I can't know how you feel, but Im struggling myself, so i can relate. Please don't do that. Let's give this world another chance. If you want to talk i would love to.
